question: Was macht der Hamster?

parts.text: zwei Eis am Stiel in die Höhe

notes: All three taps share one box (the hamster). Tap 2 box also covers the last frames where the face is visible; the phrase follows the hidden-face frames that fill most of the clip. Answer 'er' for der Hamster; answerVoice stays female as in English (voice of the clip, not the subject's sex). B1/B2 items: umklammern, verbergen, grinsen, 'in die Höhe halten'. 'das Eis am Stiel' is the everyday word for an ice cream bar (plural 'zwei Eis am Stiel').
